content: scrollbar-gutter: stable has ~65% global support as of 2024/2025, shipped in Chromium 94+ (2021) and Firefox 97+ (2022); Safari/WebKit added support later (Safari 18.2, Dec 2024) so WebKitGTK on older Linux distros likely lacks it, mirroring the color-mix() risk already documented in PITFALLS.md #24 -- but unlike color-mix(), an unsupported scrollbar-gutter declaration degrades gracefully (browser ignores the property, no invalid-value breakage), so it is safe to apply unconditionally as progressive enhancement rather than needing a JS fallback.
